title: Vanishing moment gap at zero
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q,\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $X\colon\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The difference between the $q$th power of the affine moment of order $p$ with coefficient $1$ and the $p$th power of the affine moment of order $q$ with coefficient $\rho$ is zero at $t=0$.
